levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Hazards listed are vague, or fewer than three specific hazards are named.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: At least three specific hazards are named with an exact location for each.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Same as proficient, and the learner correctly distinguishes low, medium, and high urgency across the hazards found.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: The learner touches, moves, or attempts to address a hazard directly instead of only pointing it out.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: The learner points out and reports every hazard to the adult without handling it directly.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Same as proficient, and the learner correctly explains why early reporting matters more than waiting until an injury happens.

lookFors: The learner did not touch, move, plug in, unplug, or attempt to fix any hazard themselves.
The urgency rating given to the highest-priority hazard is defensible given what was found, not just a guess.

nonDiagnosticGuard: Do not infer effort, motivation, diagnosis, or character from an error.
